如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    无视一脸防狼摸样的露露，无言转过身去，对着露露摆了摆手，说道：“好了，这样总行了吧，真是的，刚才看我洗澡的时候，我都没有那么大的反应。”
露露心里那个气啊，虽然话是那么说没错，但是无论怎么看，横看竖看，都是自己吃亏吧，做人怎么可以这么无耻呢。
“我不洗了！”露露一撇头，怄气的说道。
无言无奈的摊了摊手，都说九零后，难伺候，没想到异界的小妞也这么难伺候啊…
脸上挂着让人不禁想狠狠捶上两拳的无奈笑容，无言头也不回的对着露露说道：“那你至少把身体弄湿，要不然很容易被你的同伴怀疑的。”
的确，如果进来了那么久，连身体都没有湿，那么别人肯定会怀疑，到了那个时候，就真的不好解释了。
露露顿时一脸犹豫不决的看着无言，女孩子都爱干净，这些天来，在巨兽森林里，露露每天过着荒野露宿的生活，虽然不觉得苦，但是无法洗澡的生活，真的是让她有点忍受不了。
要不是还要进行历练的话，露露早就一甩手之下回家去了，这也是她刚开始看到湖泊，为什么会那么开心的原因。
现在，虽然经过无言的混插打岔，发生了一点意料之外的事情，但是露露想要洗澡的心情仍然没有什么改变。
说是这样说，但是无言一个大男人站在那里，浑身散发着名为‘灯泡’的光辉，让露露如何能够放下心来洗澡呢。
“可是…你还在这里…”露露近乎是委屈无比的说出了这句话，那一脸可伶兮兮的样子，肯定会让一堆男人狼嚎出声。
可惜，在场的男人，偏偏是一个不解风情的死废宅，而且还背对着美女，完全无视了这一景象，简直是应该要压出去天诛的货啊…
“那也是没办法的事情啊。”无言撇了撇嘴，说道：“要不是你的那帮同伴在外面，我早就出去了。”
这是实话，经过二十一世纪网络的轰炸，女生的身体对无言来说已经没有什么秘密可言了，虽然意义不一样，屏幕上的一切又怎么能够跟现实相比较呢，但是无言也不是色中饿鬼，虽然有点遗憾是肯定的就是了。
“那该怎么办啊？”难道要自己在他面前洗澡吗？这怎么可以…
苦恼的皱着眉头，无言只好将自己之前扔在岸边的大裤衩拿了起来，一脸嫌恶的看着手中的裤衩。
那是你自己的啊！！！喂喂！你嫌恶个毛线啊！！！
举起手来，从裤衩上撕出大大的一块碎布，无言视死如归的往自己脸上绑去。
“这样总可以了吧，你要是相信我的话，就赶紧洗洗吧。”
愕然的看着一切的发生，露露嘴角翘起，又连忙用手捂住嘴巴，强忍着爆笑出来的冲动，一副忍得很辛苦的模样。

目光紧紧的盯着无言的脸看了一会，露露才有点好笑的说道：“你绝对不能偷看哦！”
无言真的无语了。
“小露露，放心，在我们还没有达到‘恋奸情热’的情况下，我是不会急着‘吃’你的。”
露露脸一红，恨恨的剐了无言一眼，然后才有点拖拖拉拉的脱起了衣服。
听着那衣服摩擦肌肤产生的悉悉索索声还有下水的哗啦啦的声音，无言表示自己头疼了。
这不是在挑战我的忍耐力吗？为什么这个时候心眼还那么敏感啊，哥不想成为柳下惠啊！！！
“好了，你可以解开了。”
也不知道过去了多久，露露稍微有点欢乐的声音就响了起来，惊醒了正在数和尚尼姑转移注意力的无言。
解下脸上的裤衩碎布，飞快的将其撇飞出去，无言这才松了一口气。
转过头来，无言看着刚刚出水的露露，衣服此时已经穿戴完整了，湿湿的头发和滑落着水珠的肌肤都表示着其主人刚刚真的洗过澡，十分漂亮的脸蛋上此时挂满了笑容，看来能够洗一个澡对于露露来说，真的是一件十分开心的事情。
赞赏的看了露露两眼，无言真诚的说道：“还别说，丫头，真有点资本自傲了你。”
对于无言的语气稍微有点习惯了之后，露露反倒没有那么陌生了，双手插着小蛮腰，露露一脸得意的对着无言说道：“那当然了，要知道，我可是也有很多人追的。”
好笑的看着露露的表演，无言耸了耸肩膀。“是是是，露露最漂亮，最讨人喜欢了，快点出去吧。”

Ignoring Lulu's look of guarding against wolves, Wuyan turned around, waved his hand to Lulu, and said, "Okay, that's all. Really, when I saw me taking a shower just now, I didn't have such a big reaction."
Lulu was so angry in her heart. Although what she said was true, no matter how she looked at it, horizontally or vertically, she must have suffered a loss. How could a person be so shameless?
"I won't wash anymore!" Lulu said angrily, tilting her head.
Wu Yan spread his hands helplessly. People say that those born in the 1990s are difficult to take care of. I didn’t expect that girls from other worlds are so difficult to take care of...
With a helpless smile on his face that made people want to punch her hard twice, Wuyan said to Lulu without looking back: "Then at least get your body wet, otherwise you will be easily suspected by your companions."
Indeed, if you have been in for so long without even getting wet, others will definitely be suspicious. At that point, it will be really hard to explain.
Lulu looked at her speechlessly with a hesitant look on her face. Girls all love to be clean. These days, in the forest of giant beasts, Lulu has lived a life of sleeping in the wilderness every day. Although she does not feel bitter, the life of not being able to take a bath is really unbearable for her.
If she didn't have to go through the training, Lulu would have gone home without any hesitation. This is why she was so happy when she first saw the lake.
Now, even though something unexpected happened after the silent interruption, Lulu's mood of wanting to take a bath has not changed.
Although he said this, there was no words for a grown man standing there, exuding the light called a "light bulb", how could Lulu relax and take a bath.
"But... you're still here..." Lulu said this with almost aggrievedness. The pitiful look on her face would definitely make a bunch of men howl.
It's a pity that the man present turned out to be a dead loser who didn't understand the charm. Moreover, he turned his back to the beautiful woman and completely ignored this scene. He was someone who should be punished by God...
"That's something that can't be helped." Wu Yan curled his lips and said, "If it weren't for your companions outside, I would have gone out long ago."
This is the truth. After the bombardment of the Internet in the 21st century, girls' bodies have no secrets to Wuyan. Although the meaning is different, how can everything on the screen be compared with reality, but Wuyan is not a sex star, although it is a bit regretful for sure.
"What should I do?" Do you want to take a shower in front of him? How is this possible...
Frowning in distress, Wu Yan had no choice but to pick up the large pants he had thrown on the shore and looked at the pants in his hand with disgust.
That's your own! ! ! Hey hey! You hate the wool! ! !
He raised his hands, tore out a large piece of rag from his pants, and tied it to his face with a look of death.
"That's okay. If you believe me, just wash up quickly."
Watching everything happening in astonishment, Lulu raised the corners of her mouth and quickly covered her mouth with her hands, resisting the urge to burst into laughter, looking like she was having a hard time enduring it.
After staring closely at Wu Yan's face for a while, Lulu said in a funny voice: "You must not peek!"
Wuyan is really speechless.
"Little Lulu, don't worry, I won't be in a hurry to 'eat' you before we reach the point of 'love and adultery passion'."
Lu Lu blushed, gave Wu Yan a hateful look, and then took off her clothes a little lazily.
Listening to the rustling sound caused by the clothes rubbing against the skin and the splashing sound of the water, I silently expressed that I had a headache.
Doesn't this challenge my endurance? Why is my mind still so sensitive at this time?Sorry, I don’t want to be Liu Xiahui! ! !
"Okay, you can untie it."
I don’t know how much time passed before Lulu’s slightly joyful voice rang out, waking Wu Yan who was counting the monks and nuns to divert his attention.
He took off the rag of his pants on his face and quickly threw it away. Wu Yan breathed a sigh of relief.
Turning his head, Wuyan looked at Lulu who had just come out of the water. Her clothes were fully dressed at this time. Her wet hair and skin with water droplets all showed that her owner had just taken a bath. Her very beautiful face was now full of smiles. It seemed that being able to take a bath was really a very happy thing for Lulu.
He glanced at Lulu with admiration and said sincerely, "Don't mention it yet, girl, I'm really proud of you."
After getting a little used to Wu Yan's tone, Lulu was no longer so unfamiliar. With her hands on her small waist, Lulu said to Wu Yan with a proud face: "Of course, you know, there are many people chasing me."
Looking at Lulu's performance in amusement, Wuyan shrugged his shoulders. "Yes, yes, Lulu is the most beautiful and lovable. Come out quickly."
